evidence: Independent Turbo C++ 3.0 cell and pointer observations, 3 November 2026. Unchanged original DOS bundle in a private isolated loader. Original images/binaries are excluded.
scope: Active 80x23 editor at row 1 in the original 80x25 grid; semantic cells with PyTurbo's approved 9x16 atlas, not literal equality to the original 8x16 bitmap.
behavior: Arrow/page/drag scrolling changes the viewport without modifying source or caret. Horizontal end measured with a 120-character marker: after dragging to the end, 280 left-arrow clicks reveal its final character at the left edge (119 + 280 = 399). Empty vertical arrows retain their controls without scrolling. PyTurbo retains owner-approved line-end caret clamping.
